judgment_refs.phrase: practicable to stop, park or so leave such vehicle off such part of the highway
judgment_refs.note: Surveyed off-part target and shoulder geometry are measurable; practical availability remains a contextual judgment.

judgment_refs.phrase: unobstructed width of the highway opposite a standing vehicle shall be left for the free passage of other vehicles
judgment_refs.note: Measure original vehicle footprint, pavement edges and opposing vehicle path; no invented minimum width.

judgment_refs.phrase: a clear view of such stopped vehicles shall be available from a distance of 200 feet in each direction
judgment_refs.note: Separate 60.96 m approach sources and rays are geometric proxies; actual driver recognition remains open.

judgment_refs.phrase: disabled while on the paved or main-traveled portion of a highway in such manner and to such extent that it is impossible to avoid stopping and temporarily leaving such disabled vehicle in such position
judgment_refs.note: Engine failure injection, body position and duration are measured; genuine disability, impossibility and temporary character require source review.

sweep_specs.rationale: Physical target position and disabled context compared while all legal judgments stay unresolved. A numeric sweep requires an original surveyed highway and a separately pinned physical axis.
missing_inputs: original surveyed highway geometry and verified numeric target offsets for a continuous position sweep
